Hi Vivek,

Hope you’re well. Our renewal for the Dedicated pool is coming up at the end of February and the team wants to formally request an increase from 8 → 16 reserved GPUs starting with the next term. Primary asks from our side: 
- Updated monthly commit (we expect a steady increase in production tokens)
- Throughput guarantees for peak windows (our inference spiky, need predictable p99 latency)
- A phased activation plan so we can validate model performance incrementally

Can you share a proposed amendment and any pricing impact? Carlos (cc) is our procurement lead — he’ll own contract logistics.

Thanks,

Omniscience

Samantha — thanks for the clear asks. We’d be happy to support a 2x capacity increase. High-level proposal below; attaching a draft order form and an SLA spreadsheet with throughput/latency targets.

Proposal (summary):
- Term: 12 months (renewal start 2026-03-01)
- Capacity: reserved pool increase from 8 → 16 A100-equivalent GPUs
- Monthly commit: $XX,XXX/month (updated billing units) — reflects a ~12% uplift vs. list for the larger pool; breakouts in attached OrderForm
- Throughput SLOs: p95 and p99 latency bands by sequence length; see 'Throughput_SLA_8to16.xlsx'
- Activation: phased (4 GPU increments over 30 days) with a single-day test window after each increment
- One-time activation credit: we can offer a $4,000 credit to help offset migration validation costs (subject to signature)

Action items:
1) I’ve looped in Marissa (sales ops) to finalize pricing/DocuSign flow.
2) If you confirm the phased schedule and credit, I’ll send an amendment + updated order form for signature.
3) Karthik (I’ll put him on the thread next) can coordinate the activation runbook.

Attaching: Redwood_OrderForm_OMNI_v2.pdf; Throughput_SLA_8to16.xlsx

— Vivek

Samantha — quick technical confirmation from my side:
- Test windows: 48-hour validation after each 4-GPU activation (we measure latency, throughput, and KV cache hit rate).
- Warm-up guidance: staggered traffic ramp (20% → 50% → 100% over the 48h) and a short prefix-cache pre-warm job we can run for you. This minimizes cold-start token cost.
- Operational points: we’ll provide an activation runbook and a Slack channel for real-time alerts; post-activation we’ll capture a 7-day telemetry baseline to verify SLOs.

If procurement signs the attached order form, we can schedule activation windows starting the week of 2026-03-08. Any chance you can confirm approval by next Tuesday so we can reserve capacity?

— Karthik
